summary: Tested i18n translations across DataPulse app. Found and fixed critical bug: 't is not defined' ReferenceError in DashboardLayout.jsx. After fix, all navigation labels and app pages translate correctly to Spanish and French.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: Missing useTranslation() hook call - 't is not defined' ReferenceError

critical_code_review_comments: DashboardLayout.jsx was importing useTranslation from react-i18next but not calling it to get the t function, causing 'ReferenceError: t is not defined'
Fix applied: Added 'const { t } = useTranslation();' inside DashboardLayout component
All navigation labels use translation keys (labelKey, fallback) pattern and translate correctly
Translation files (en.json, es.json, fr.json) contain all necessary keys for app pages

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All i18n features working after fix

context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n is fully functional. Language selector works (data-testid='language-selector-btn'). Spanish (es) and French (fr) translations verified on navigation, Dashboard, Forms, Projects, Settings, Submissions, and Team pages. The fix added useTranslation hook to DashboardLayout.jsx component.

features_tested.dashboard_spanish: PASS - Proyectos Totales, Formularios Activos, Envíos, Tendencias de Envíos, Calidad de Datos
features_tested.dashboard_french: PASS - Projets Totaux, Formulaires Actifs, Soumissions, Tendances des Soumissions, Qualité des Données

rca_of_the_issue.issue: App crashed with 'ReferenceError: t is not defined' after login
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: DashboardLayout.jsx imported useTranslation from react-i18next but never called the hook to get the t() function. The component used t() in JSX without having it defined in scope.
reproduction_steps: 3. App crashes with 'Uncaught runtime errors: t is not defined'
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added 'const { t } = useTranslation();' at the start of DashboardLayout component function, right after other hook calls
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Tested language switching between English, Spanish, and French - all navigation labels translate correctly
